hypothesis: A smaller or more tightly anchored PPO micro-smoke from M163 may retain the M164 boundary success-drop signal that M165 lost by one row.
success_criteria: initialize from the M163 boundary-outcome actor update
use a shorter or stricter PPO recipe than M165
keep actor inputs unchanged and do not expose M162 labels or hidden dynamics
pass behavior retention on zero-relvel seeds 9503 and 9504
pass the M164 boundary replay gate with no success-drop count regression
state whether longer PPO is admitted
failure_criteria: reuse the failed M165 checkpoint as a starting point
relax the M164 success-drop retention threshold after seeing the result
accept PPO based only on behavior and protected-key retention
weaken the M164 fixed boundary replay signal

commands.name: m166_ppo_micro_smoke
commands.command: Try a smaller or more strongly anchored PPO micro-smoke from M163 and gate it with the same M165 checks.

decision_rule: Admit longer PPO only if the micro-smoke passes the full M165 gate set without relaxing the M164 boundary replay thresholds.
